name: App Shell Navigation and Window Lifecycle
description: Navigation model: views, routes, deep links, window creation/destruction, multi-window state sharing.
purpose: Navigation is predictable and state is coherent across windows.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation actions are dispatched through a central router, not ad-hoc URL construction
Window creation opens at a specified route and inherits parent window context
Window destruction drains in-flight operations and persists view state before close
Multi-window state is synchronized through a shared store, not direct cross-window references
Deep links resolve to routes and navigate within existing window or open new window
Navigation history is preserved per-window with back/forward semantics
required_evidence: Central router dispatch test (no ad-hoc URL construction)
Window creation at route with inherited context test
Window destruction drains in-flight ops and persists state test
acceptance_gates: Window creation opens at specified route with inherited context
Window destruction drains ops and persists state
Multi-window state shared through store, not cross-window references
Deep links resolve to routes in existing or new window
rollback_strategy: Navigation failure rolls back to previous route; window creation failure does not create partial window
recovery_strategy: On window crash, restore window state from shared store on next open
escalation_policy: Navigation routing failures escalate to user with route and fallback option
